text: Over the past 30 days, visitors have raised concerns primarily about the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviews mention issues with the limited menu and the preparation of certain items, including a grilled cheese sandwich and potato salad. Wait times and service were also noted by some guests, though less frequently. Overall, the average rating remains positive, but attention to the food offerings and dining experience could improve visitor satisfaction.

windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitor reviews of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have highlighted significant issues with the food service. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service problems were noted, including long wait times and periods when kitchen orders were not being taken. While the library itself received some positive remarks, the café’s current food offerings and service logistics need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.

While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s current food offerings and service logistics need attention to better meet visitor expectations.
